verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants manage flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows on the user's behalf. That means natural-language operation is possible, but only through an external AI assistant connected to that server; there is no native natural-language interface in the product. missing for 10: built-in natural-language command interface in the dashboard, hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP workflow, documentation of which operations work reliably by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf — in a human-in-the-loop IDE session, or fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline.
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
